"''And those who oppose it are more powerful than you'll ever be.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Maul|audio=ObiWan-Maul-DarkSide.flac|}} '''Obi-Wan Kenobi''' was a legendary [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council]] during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Republic Era]]. As a [[High Jedi General]], Kenobi served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] that fought against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]], and was nicknamed "'''the Negotiator'''." Kenobi, however, was forced into [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] as a result of the [[Great Jedi Purge]] initiated by the Republic's own [[clone trooper]]s when Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]], secretly [[Darth Sidious]], implemented [[Order 66]]. As a mentor, Kenobi was responsible for [[Jedi training|training]] two members of the [[Skywalker family]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Anakin]] and [[Luke Skywalker]], both of whom served in turn as his [[Padawan]] in the ways of [[the Force]]. Kenobi was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Stewjon]] in [[57 BBY]]. He was Force-sensitive, and therefore taken from [[Kenobi family|his family]] and [[Jedi Initiate|inducted]] into the [[Jedi Order]] as a [[Youngling|child]]. Raised in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Grand Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant]], Kenobi was assigned to [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]. In [[32 BBY]], Kenobi attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] by [[Battle of Naboo|defeating]] the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. He also chose to train Anakin Skywalker—the prophesied [[Chosen One]] who was destined to destroy the [[Sith]] and restore balance to the Force—having promised Jinn who [[Death|died]] in the [[lightsaber duel]] against Maul. With the [[First Battle of Geonosis|advent]] of the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars in [[22 BBY]], Kenobi adopted the [[military rank]] of High Jedi General in the Grand [[Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], and was given command of the [[Open Circle Fleet]], the [[Third Systems Army]], and the [[7th Sky Corps]]. [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody]] served as his second-in-command throughout [[the galaxy]]-wide conflict, with their forces achieving multiple victories over the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the midst of the war, his old enemy Maul re-emerged into [[Galaxy|galactic]] affairs, bent on revenge against Kenobi for his debilitating defeat [[Standard decade|decades]] prior. Though they clashed in heated duels on multiple occasions, Maul failed to end Kenobi's life or cripple his spirit, despite murdering his former love, [[Satine Kryze]], [[Duchess]] of [[Mandalore]]. In [[19 BBY]], Kenobi killed the Separatist [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]], [[General]] [[Grievous]], during the [[Battle of Utapau]], effectively ending the Clone Wars. He later survived the initial onslaught of the Great Jedi Purge against the Jedi Order, which resulted from the [[Grand Plan|machinations]] of the Sith [[Lord]] Darth Sidious. After discovering that Skywalker had betrayed the Jedi and turned to the [[dark side of the Force]], becoming Sidious' [[Sith apprentice]] under the name of [[Darth]] Vader, Kenobi [[Duel on Mustafar|defeated]] his former Padawan on [[Mustafar]] and exiled himself to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine]] as the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Era|rose to power]]. Adopting a [[hermit]] lifestyle as "'''Ben Kenobi'''," he watched over Vader's and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s son, Luke. [[9 BBY|Ten years later]], Kenobi left exile to [[Search for Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], Luke's [[twin]] sister, and was pursued by the Empire's [[Inquisitorius]] and Vader himself. Later, Kenobi was hunted down once again by Maul, whom he finally slew to protect the young Luke. Kenobi began the boy's Jedi training in [[1 BBY]], and soon after [[Rescue of Princess Leia|encountered]] Vader aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first]] [[Death Star]], where he sacrificed himself to ensure that Luke and his allies escaped from the Sith Lord. In death, Kenobi became [[Immortality|one with the Force]] which allowed him to continue guiding Luke throughout the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY]], Kenobi reunited with his former student, Anakin Skywalker, who died [[Battle of Endor|destroying]] his [[Sith Master]] in order to save his son. Kenobi was remembered as a legendary Jedi Master during the [[New Republic Era|rise]] of the [[New Republic]]; [[Ben Solo]], the son of Luke's twin sister, Princess Leia Organa, was named after Kenobi. Solo's [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|turn to the dark side]] left Luke disillusioned with the Jedi Order's legacy, and he held Kenobi responsible for Anakin's transformation into Vader. However, Luke's faith would eventually be restored with the aid of Darth Sidious's granddaughter [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], to whom Kenobi would lend his voice and strength in a [[Battle of Exegol|final battle and victory]] against her resurrected ancestor on [[Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]].
